body:
Two pricing defects in pricing.py:

1. `apply_bulk_discount` uses `if len(items) > 5` so exactly five items do not receive the 10% bulk discount. It should be `>= 5`.
2. `calculate_total` truncates with `int(total)` so a total of 99.99 becomes 99 instead of rounding to the nearest cent (100). It should round.

Both are covered by failing tests in test_pricing.py.
title: Bulk discount not applied at exactly five items, and totals truncate instead of rounding
